body:
Hey @usualoma !

What do you think? It's interesting results.

@usualoma 

I got it!

I agree switching to `ES2022`, but it has been already done!  Actually, `tsconfig.json` was updated to `ES2022` in PR #2224 that was merged into "next". I built "next" and benchmarked it again and found no performance degradation. Therefore, there is no need for this PR.

Fortunately, you are right, the file size is smaller than I thought it would be! The following is the result of minify and build of "Hello World" with Wranlger.

```
// ES2020
hono => Total Upload: 20.15 KiB / gzip: 7.42 KiB
hono/tiny => Total Upload: 12.74 KiB / gzip: 4.69 KiB
```

```
// ES2022
hono => Total Upload: 18.46 KiB / gzip: 7.09 KiB
hono/tiny => Total Upload: 11.12 KiB / gzip: 4.38 KiB
```

Nice! Now let's close this PR. Thanks!
Perhaps we can also make `@hono/node-server` better because it is now using `ES2020`.
